description: OpenCode agent (opencode-ai), speaking the runner protocol. Models come from Settings → Providers through the mothership gateway; the module holds no credential.
name: OpenCode

disabled_tools.description: Comma-separated OpenCode tool names this colony is never allowed to call, such as bash, webfetch or task; the tools stay in the model's context but every call is denied. edit covers write, edit and apply_patch as one permission, so those cannot be switched off separately, and MCP tools are not covered. Empty disables nothing.
disabled_tools.title: Disabled tools

model.description: Model for the agent as <provider>/<model> from Settings → Providers, e.g. local/deepseek-v4-flash. Required: OpenCode colonies reach models only through the gateway.
model.title: Model

small_model.description: Model for titles and summaries as <provider>/<model>. Empty uses the main model.
small_model.title: Small model
